display_name: イントロ旋律（ギター用）
instrument: guitar, standard tuning, 7th position - ARRANGEMENT of the violin's intro line (bars 1-11) incl. its open-D/open-A drone; the real acoustic-guitar part is guitar.json
notes_ja: 【v3で直したところ】バイオリンだけを分離した音で確かめると、1〜6小節は前の版より1オクターブ上でした（A3→A4、C4→C5、B3→B4）。左手は7ポジションのままで、3弦7＝D4、2弦10＝A4、1弦7・8・10＝B4・C5・D5です。3弦7の人差し指は押さえたままにして、D4を下で鳴らし続けると、バイオリンの重音（開放弦Dのドローン）に近くなります。2・4・6小節の後半は「C5・B4・A4・C5・B4・C5」と動き、最後のC5（1弦8へハンマリング）は3つとも同じ形です（3拍目の最後のA4は小さめに）。3小節の頭はD5（1弦10）とD4を同時に弾き直します（2小節の終わりで先にD5へ上がらないこと）。7小節2拍目はC5を3つ分伸ばしたままです（B4には下りません）。10小節の頭はA4を弾かず、9小節から伸ばしたC5をそのまま保ちます。8・10小節の最後は「B4 → A4（16分）→ C5（16分、1弦8を軽く）→ 次の小節頭のA4」で、C5はアイリッシュの『カット』です。8小節3拍目は16分で1弦7→10とハンマリングし、10→7とプリングします。11小節はD5を弾かず、2拍目の頭から3弦7のD4だけを伸ばし、3拍目の3つ目の8分と小節最後の8分で弾き直します（バイオリンの弓の返しに合わせたもので、伸ばしたままでもかまいません）。（検証メモ）1〜6小節では、同じ動きが1オクターブ下（A3・C4・B3）でも小さく重なって聞こえます。この譜面は、より大きく聞こえる上のオクターブを弾く形です。
method: v3 RE-VERIFICATION of the 7th-position guitar arrangement of the violin line (bars 1-11) against the clean MVSep Mega-53 violin stem (mid channel, 0-18.6 s). Scripts/images: work/v3/vline2/. PITCH ENSEMBLE: SwiftF0 (4 phase-shifted runs -> 4 ms hop), torchcrepe full + tiny (5 ms hop, weighted-argmax), PESTO (5 ms step), each thresholded on its own confidence, resampled to a 5 ms grid and median-voted (>= 2 voters and a majority of the voiced members; members 12 st off the winning cluster are counted as octave errors and ignored). Run on the raw stem and on a copy with the open-D harmonic series (k x 293.73 Hz, k=1..24) notched out so that the melody above the drone can be tracked. Octave errors were then rejected spectrally: a voted pitch whose own fundamental and 3rd partial are both >= 12 dB below the partial one octave up is re-read an octave higher (245 of 2766 notched frames, all in bars 1-6). ONSETS: common.onsets() on the stem (94 reference onsets in bars 1-11) plus clean-partial level rises (partials that no open-D harmonic touches), 2.5-10 kHz bow-noise flux, and narrowband (4096-pt) and CQT zooms per bar. D5 vs the open D's 2nd harmonic: level h2-h1 against D-alone references (-6..0 dB) plus the h2 frequency offset/vibrato relative to 2 x h1. FINDINGS / CHANGES vs v2: (1) Bars 1-6 were one octave too low. In the violin stem the 'A3' slots have no 220 Hz energy at all (-64..-85 dB vs -21..-35 dB at 440 Hz) and the C/B notes have their odd low-octave partials (h1,h3,h5,h7 of C4/B3) 14-25 dB under the even ones, while the clean C5/B4 of bars 7-8 have the same upper-octave spectrum; the guitar stems carry the A3 (the accompaniment's D3/A3 drone), not the violin. So the violin plays the open-D drone with open-A double stops (D4 + A4) and the figure C5-B4-A4 / C5-B4-C5 on the A string: A3->A4, C4->C5, B3->B4 throughout (same 7th-position frets as bars 7-11: s3 7 = D4, s2 10 = A4, s1 7/8/10 = B4/C5/D5). The v2 rhythm of the drone (A4 entering at pos 2 and 8, D4 re-bowed at 0 and 6) was confirmed by level rises; the quieter C4/B3 component (about 17 dB under C5/B4, absent from every guitar stem) is not part of this line. Ensemble frames at the notated pitch in bars 1-6: 0.337 -> 0.469; duration-weighted stem level at the notated fundamentals in bars 1-6: -42.1 -> -21.2 dB. (2) Bars 2/4/6 second half: C5 (6) B4 (7) A4 (8, soft) C5 (9) B4 (10) and then C5 at 11 in bars 4/6 (C5 3-7 dB over A4 at 11-11.5; ensemble C5 from 10.99/11.33); bar 2 ends B4 (10) C5 (11, 16th) D5 (11.5, tied): the bar-3 D5 is already +9.7 dB at 11-11.5 and +15 dB at 11.5-12 (and 20 c off 2 x D4, i.e. a separate stopped D5). [SUPERSEDED by the verification: the D5 starts on the bar-3 downbeat; bar 2 now ends C5 (11, 8th, h) like bars 4/6.] (3) Bar 7 beat 2: C5 held 3-6 (all four trackers within +-15 c of C5 for pos 3-6.5), so v2's B4 p (4) / C5 h (5) were removed. (4) Bar 8: C5 tied over from bar 7 (no downbeat or pos-2 re-pick; C5 just decays until the D4 + bow change at 3), B4 at 4; the D5 'grace' is a 16th D5 at 6.5 (h2-h1 +8.6 dB at 6.4-6.9) written as 7h10 / 10p7; C5 arrives at 9 directly (C5 salience -31/-25/-13 dB at 8.5/8.75/9), so v2's C5 h at 8.5 was removed. (5) Bars 8 and 10 endings: B4 (10), A4 at 11 (onsets at 10.74/10.75, A4 +14..+20 dB), then a 16th C5 'cut' at 11.5 (ensemble C5 at 11.3-11.7 in bar 10, B4+67 c rising to C5 in bar 8), and the next bar's A4 on the downbeat; v2's B4 grace (s2 12p10) on the bar 9/11 downbeats is replaced by this C5 16th. (6) Bar 9: A4 held 0-3 (no re-pick at 2), C5 (3), B4 (4), C5 hammered back at 5.5 (ensemble C5 at 5.43-5.99), B4 + D4 at 6. (7) Bar 10 beat 1: no A4 and no D4 - the C5 of bar 9 pos 8.5 is held (tied) into bar 10 (A4 band -50..-60 dB, D4 absent 14.2-14.43 s); v2's A4+D4 (0) and B4 (2) were removed. (8) Bar 11: no independent D5: h2-h1 is +5.4 dB at pos 3-4 and falls to -10.7 dB by pos 10-11 (lone open-D references -6..0 dB, stopped D5s of bars 7/10 +9..+25 dB), and the 587 Hz partial stays within 0.7-1.2 c (sd) of 2 x D4 (bar 10's D5: 2-4 c). Written A4 (0-3) then D4 (3), D4 re-bows at 8 (onset 7.88) and 11 (onset 10.74). Kept from v2: bar 7 A4 (0) and soft B4 (2) sliding to C5, D5 (+9 dB) at bar 7 pos 6 and bar 10 pos 6 (+21..+25 dB), D5 in bar 3 (0-1) and bar 5 (6-8) (+10..+15 dB), B4 at pos 4 in bars 8-10, C5 hammer at 8.5 in bars 7/9/10. METRICS vs the violin stem (pluck synth incl. graces/16ths; reference onsets = common.onsets of the stem; v2 -> v3): onset F30 0.383 -> 0.386, F50 0.59 -> 0.602 (P 0.607 -> 0.646, R 0.574 -> 0.564); bars 7-11 F30/F50 0.519/0.675 -> 0.551/0.725; bars 1-6 0.283/0.528 -> 0.28/0.523 (unchanged rhythm; the stem's detected onsets there trail the soft double-stop entries by 40-80 ms, so F is low for both); chroma per half bar 0.796 -> 0.826; octave-aware semitone-CQT cosine per 16th 0.709 -> 0.733 (bars 1-6 0.633 -> 0.658, bars 7-11 0.801 -> 0.822); ensemble pitch agreement bars 7-11 0.77 -> 0.839. The D5 belongs to the bar-3 downbeat: its 587 Hz level stays flat through bar 2 pos 10.5-11.7 (Mega violin 16th means -16.7/-17.0/-18.1 dB, 35-ms frames -20.5..-21.5 dB) and rises only from pos 11.8-11.85 (+9.5 dB by the downbeat; plateau at bar 3 pos 0.2); onset detectors fire at bar-3 pos -0.14/-0.14/-0.10 (violin/sw6o/h6o), the usual 15-25 ms anticipation of this player (cf. the bar-5 D4 bow attack, which starts at bar 4 pos 11.6 and is written on the downbeat). OPEN / CORRECTED STATEMENT: the octave-lower component in bars 1-6 is much stronger than the transcriber's '17 dB under' (that is the Mega stem only). In the mix and both other separations C4 is only 3-11 dB under C5 (C4 -13..-18 dB, its 3rd partial G5 -21..-32 dB) and B3 1-21 dB under B4 (B3 -21..-37 dB), with A3-series partials in bars 1-6 as well (E5 -22..-43 dB vs -47..-64 in bars 7-8), absent from bars 7-11 and from every guitar stem. torchfcpe (all D-notched stems, incl. the Mega violin) and basic-pitch (C4 posteriors 0.34-0.54 vs C5/B4 0.24-0.39 on sw6o/h6o) hear the LOWER octave in bars 1-6, because the combined periodicity is the lower one. Whether it is a separate octave-down layer (the Mega violin model keeps C5 within 4-6 dB of the mix and B4 within 6-12 dB but cuts C4 by 12-14 dB, as it cuts the loud C4 at 13b) or the fundamental of a G-string violin tone (the bars 2/4/6 C5 has its 2nd partial 18-31 dB down vs 14 dB for the bar-7 C5) is not resolved; C4/C5 phase coherence over 0.85-eighth notes is inconclusive (R 0.19-0.76). The upper octave is kept (louder layer, same 7th-position frets as bars 7-11) and notes_ja now mentions the lower layer. Also still uncertain: the 16th C5 'cut' at pos 11.5 of bars 8/10 (torchfcpe on the violin stem shows A4 throughout; only a +8 dB C5-band bump), the drone re-picks at pos 3 in bars 2-6 (stem onsets near 3.0 only in bars 2 and 4) and a weak 587 Hz component in bar 11 pos 0-3.
